note: Read by tools/restructure/move.mjs. `homes`: the folder of a feature when it is not named like the feature (structure-conventions, section 2: `ai-local.js` goes to `server/ai/`). `features` and `files`: loose files of `server/` that stay where they are on purpose, each with the reason the report prints. `shims`: old paths that keep their one line after `move.mjs unshim`, because something outside this repo loads them by that path.

features.updates: the updater: installers and the app's bootstrap name these files, and an install replaces them while it runs them

files.server/remote-access.js: the gate lists of paired devices and the order of their checks: every note and review points at this path
files.server/disk-categories.js: the closed list of what may be deleted: left alone with the gate lists
files.server/linux-collectors.js: shared by many features (structure-conventions, section 5: collectors keep their paths)
files.server/darwin-collectors.js: shared by many features (structure-conventions, section 5: collectors keep their paths)

shims.server/community-catalog.js: the checks of the creator skill load it by this path and find the repo by it
shims.server/community-messages.js: the launch check of the creator skill loads it by this path
shims.server/icon-packs.js: the contract tests of Xenon Maker and the icon check of the creator skill load it by this path
shims.server/sound-packs.js: the contract tests of Xenon Maker and the sound check of the creator skill load it by this path
